Memory spaces and concepts, search, recall and snapshot imports.

## List memory spaces

`GET /v1/memory/spaces` (SDK method `listMemorySpaces`)

The spaces the caller may read, oldest first: the organisation's, a project's to those who may view it, and a person's own. A person never sees another person's space.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | no |  (minimum 1, maximum 500) |
| `cursor` | string | no | A previous page's `nextCursor`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [MemorySpacePage](/api/reference/types/#memoryspacepage) (`application/json`). A page of spaces.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create a memory space

`POST /v1/memory/spaces` (SDK method `createMemorySpace`)

People and API keys only, never an agent; a deployment may ask for more, such as the organisation's admin role.

**Body**: [CreateMemorySpaceBody](/api/reference/types/#creatememoryspacebody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [MemorySpace](/api/reference/types/#memoryspace) (`application/json`). The new space.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List a space's concepts

`GET /v1/memory/spaces/{spaceId}/concepts` (SDK method `listConcepts`)

By ID, every status unless `status` names one.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spaceId` | string | yes | The space's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | [ConceptStatus](/api/reference/types/#conceptstatus) | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no |  (minimum 1, maximum 500) |
| `cursor` | string | no | A previous page's `nextCursor`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [ConceptPage](/api/reference/types/#conceptpage) (`application/json`). A page of concepts.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a concept

`GET /v1/memory/spaces/{spaceId}/concepts/{conceptId}` (SDK method `getConcept`)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spaceId` | string | yes | The space's ID. |
| `conceptId` | string | yes | The concept's ID, its slashes encoded (`projects%2Fharbour%2Fregion`). |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Concept](/api/reference/types/#concept) (`application/json`). The concept.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Search memory

`POST /v1/memory/search` (SDK method `searchMemory`)

Keyword search over the named spaces' concepts, best first, as a person browsing them would.

**Body**: [MemorySearchBody](/api/reference/types/#memorysearchbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [MemorySearchResult](/api/reference/types/#memorysearchresult) (`application/json`). The matches.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Recall memory for a task

`POST /v1/memory/recall` (SDK method `recallMemory`)

What a session would be given for this query: the profile, the best matches (BM25) and their exceptions, rendered, with a manifest of what was recalled and why.

**Body**: [RecallBody](/api/reference/types/#recallbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Recall](/api/reference/types/#recall) (`application/json`). The recall.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Load a snapshot into a space

`POST /v1/memory/spaces/{spaceId}/snapshot` (SDK method `importMemorySnapshot`)

A host adapter's load path: the space's concepts become the snapshot's, recorded with its source and ref, so every recall names what it read. People and API keys only; a deployment may ask for more.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spaceId` | string | yes | The space's ID. |

**Body**: [MemorySnapshot](/api/reference/types/#memorysnapshot)

**Answers**

- `200`: [MemorySpace](/api/reference/types/#memoryspace) (`application/json`). The space, with its snapshot.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
